description: The largest holders of an ERC-20 token on Base, ranked, each with balance and percent of supply, marked wallet, contract or burn. Gives top 1, 5 and 10 concentration (burns excluded), a wallets-only share, burned percent, total holder count, and a low/moderate/high/very high level. Ranking from Blockscout's index; balances verified on-chain. Can take up to 25 seconds. Not charged for invalid input or if the index can't answer. Paid via x402; see list_prices.

limit.description: How many holders to list, 1 to 50 (default 10).

name: token_holders
title: Top holders of a Base token and how concentrated its supply is
